newsitem.title: UK: Britain's AEA opens osteoporosis centre.
newsitem.headline: Britain's AEA opens osteoporosis centre.

text.p: British science and nuclear technology company AEA Technology Plc said on Monday it was opening a clinical trials centre to concentrate on osteoporosis research.
The 1.2 million stg ($2 million) centre would help AEA more easily recruit volunteers to take part in clinical trials for pharmaceutical companies, the company said in a statement.
AEA said trials underway now concentrated on anti-resorptives, which help stop the body from re-absorbing calcium. This process helps cause the bone loss seen commonly after menopause in women.
It is also testing anabolic drugs, which help restore bone mass.

AEA, spun off from the state-owned Atomic Energy Authority last year, this year saw a rise in annual pre-tax profits to 18.5 million stg from 15.8 million previously. -- London Newsroom 0171-542-8958 ($ = 0.604 British Pounds)
